fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s economic conditions and banking credit, city commission politics and appointments, and disputes over municipal management. Coverage addresses entertainment policy in city parks and the impact on local union musicians, transportation regulation in Miami Beach affecting jitneys and private buses, and public safety topics including a fire attributed to lack of water-main notification. The issue also comments on federal enforcement and violence connected to rum-running near Biscayne Bay, civic incidents involving display of the American flag, and includes local columns, advertisements, and sports notices (including boxing and bicycle races).
